title: .NET release-notes components manifest
description: Defines the product components that the release-notes agentic workflow uses to partition features into per-component branches and editorial sections. This file describes the product surface (what readers see); it does not describe teams or org structure.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Incremented when the component schema or semantics change in a backward-incompatible way.

components.description: Ordered list of components. Order influences presentation in rolled-up views; classification is by id, not position.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used as the branch suffix and matrix key (e.g., 'runtime' produces 'release-notes/dotnet-11-preview-3-runtime'). Must be unique within this file and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.

title.description: Human-readable component name used in release-notes headings.

repos.description: Repositories whose PRs are deterministically assigned to this component. A feature whose primary PR comes from a listed repo is assigned to this component without LLM classification. May be empty for components with no canonical repo (e.g., the 'general' fallback).

areas.description: Area labels (or glob-like patterns) used to refine repo-based assignment when a single repo serves multiple components. Patterns ending in '*' match any suffix. May be empty.

content_dir.description: Directory where this component's editorial markdown lives. The token '{milestone}' is substituted with the active milestone path segment (e.g., '11.0/preview/preview3') at workflow time.

fallback_component.description: Id of the component that receives features which match no repo and no area. Must reference an id present in the components array. Intended to be a low-trust holding bucket reviewed manually before merge.
